description: This circular walk explores the area around the village of Michaelston Le Pit in the Vale of Glamorgan. It's a nice varied walk with riverside trails along the Cadoxton River and peaceful woodland paths in Casehill Woods. The route also visits the Salmon Leaps which lie just to the west of the village. The Leaps are located in a beautiful glacial valley with the surrounding woodlands of Cwm George forming a lovely backdrop. The best time to see actual salmon leaping upstream is during the late summer and autumn, particularly after heavy rain, when they migrate to spawn.
